name: Broadcast 4K - Default
prompt: Cinematic broadcast-style football match, photorealistic 4K ultra-high detail. A striker in a vibrant red-and-white jersey sprints down the right flank of a perfectly manicured green pitch under bright stadium floodlights. Low-angle tracking camera follows the player at knee/waist level, dynamic motion blur on the ball and legs, shallow depth of field with bokeh on crowd, dramatic lens flare from floodlights, packed 80,000-seat stadium with green-and-white seating tiers visible, roaring crowd, realistic sweat and fabric detail, wind-blown jersey, strong rim lighting, studio-grade sports cinematography, Unreal Engine 5 quality lighting and global illumination, filmic color grading, 85mm lens, f/1.8, high dynamic range, hyper-real details. No logos or watermarks.
negatives: lowres, watermark, text, logo, jersey-branding, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, cartoon, oversaturated skin, duplicate-objects, jpeg-artifacts
notes: Use SDXL or high-quality diffusion model for photoreal detail. Avoid brand names.

name: Wet Pitch - Night Rain
prompt: Cinematic broadcast-style football match at night with light rain, photorealistic 4K. A striker in a vibrant red-and-white jersey sprints down the right flank on a wet, reflective pitch. Stadium floodlights create dramatic reflections and glints on the surface. Low-angle tracking camera with motion blur on ball and splashing water, droplets visible, volumetric light beams, strong rim lighting, packed 80,000-seat stadium, crowd blurred with DOF bokeh, fabric and wet textures highly detailed, cinematic color grade, film grain, Unreal Engine quality lighting.
negatives: lowres, watermark, text, logo, cartoon, deformed anatomy, oversaturated colors, motion artifacts
notes: Add wetness/reflection emphasis and raindrop microdetails. Use motion blur plus splash particle details.
